Name: Pig to Rabbit Sound
Author: Hildegard333
Description:
Since the "Pig to Fox" sound mod no longer works because the Sound Effect Replacement Mod  isn't being updated anymore, I thought I'd try my hand at making a mod that works with Sound Tweaker. This is my first public mod!


Original Idea: "Pig to Fox" sound mod (by o0MrPro - found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12755)
Sound Effect Replacement Mod (by aedenthorn - found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232)
Sound Tweaker (by aedenthorn - found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767)

Manifest.Name: PigToRabbitSound
Manifest.Description: Changes annoying pig sound to    snuffling rabbit sound.
Manifest.Author: Hildegard333
